title: eritrichium glomeratum var. virgatum
intro: Eritrichium glomeratum var. virgatum, commonly known as the alpine fleabane, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Boraginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of alpine fleabane include its ability to reduce inflammation, calm digestive issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Eritrichium glomeratum var. virgatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
